events.verdict: Hendricks (UTA) contests Aldama's (MEM) shot attempt at the rim and the marginal contact does not affect his shot attempt.
Smart (BOS) does not establish himself in a legal guarding position before the contact with Sexton (UTA) during his drive. Smart is still moving laterally at the time of the illegal contact.
Kessler (UTA) and Huff (MEM) lock arms and Bane (MEM) briefly grasps Kessler's arm during the rebound. The players are not in position for the rebound and the contact is considered marginal.
Clarkson (UTA) grazes Morant's (MEM) arm as he dribbles on the perimeter but Morant loses control of the ball on his own.
Morant (MEM) dives for the loose ball and there is incidental contact with Hendricks (UTA) that does not affect his ability to control the ball and make the pass.
Aldama (MEM) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball prior to any incidental body contact with Markkanen (UTA) during his drive in transition.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds called on Aldama (MEM) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Markkanen is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds and there is no proximate foul on Aldama during the play. Possession is awarded to Memphis when play resumes.
Kessler (UTA) jumps vertically and the contact with Smart (MEM) during his shot attempt is incidental.
Huff (MEM) does not jump vertically and turns into George's (UTA) body while he is airborne, affecting his driving shot attempt.
Kessler (UTA) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Morant's (MEM) driving shot attempt.

Smart (MEM) establishes himself in a defensive position, but begins falling before any contact occurs with George (UTA). George is able to slip any body contact with Smart and Smart initiates illegal leg contact that affects George's driving shot attempt.

Clarkson (UTA) grazes Aldama's (MEM) head and does not affect his attempt to pass. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
George (UTA) commits a take foul on Bane (MEM).
Clarkson (UTA) has his arm extended as Bane (MEM) attempts to move around him to contest the jump shot attempt and the contact is marginal.
George (UTA) attempts to commit a take foul on Aldama (MEM) after he releases the pass but the contact is marginal.
